name: rustyleaf
description: A high-performance Rust-based map visualization engine powered by WebAssembly and WebGL2

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm && webpack --mode production
scripts.prepack: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/.npmignore','# keep: stops npm from applying wasm-pack generated dist/.gitignore\n')"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:wasm && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:visual: npm run build:wasm && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/tests/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:soak: npm run build:wasm && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/tests/memory-soak.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:fps: npm run build:wasm && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/tests/00-fps-benchmark.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:update: npm run build:wasm && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.bench: node -e "console.log('Run: npm run build && node e2e/serve.mjs, then open http://localhost:3333/benchmark/')"

author: Mehdi
